meta.notes: Every metric reproduces a canonical query supplied by the business. ORDERS: view_reports.oms_sales_union, date window only, no status or validity filters, no deduplication; total order value = SUM(sales); AOV = SUM(sales)/COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) (aovMethod total_over_orders). LEADS: temp.source_wise_funnel, one row per phone, pincode column `pincodes`, cohort anchored on created_on. Conversion joins the lead's phone to oms_sales_union.shipping_phone, both normalised to the last 10 digits, restricted to the SAME pincode and the same window. WINDOW: rolling 6 months ending on the pull date; METRICS_PERIOD_ANCHOR=week advances the pull date weekly, so the window follows the refresh cadence. NOTE: source_wise_funnel lives in the `temp` dataset -- a production metric depends on a table in a scratch namespace. view_reports.lead_base is the equivalent in a stable dataset and gives a slightly larger denominator (3,030 vs 2,997 leads for 560076); see config/schema.mapping.lead-base.json.
